children: Allogene Therapeutics Chief Financial Officer Geoffrey Parker will retire later this year, adding to the changes at the top for the biotechnology company after Zachary Roberts was elevated to chief executive.
The San Francisco-based company said Parker will retire effective Nov. 6, and will continue to lead finances through that date as Allogene conducts an external search for a successor.
It comes after former Chief Medical Officer Roberts recently transitioned to the role of president and CEO, succeeding David Chang following eight years of leadership.
